ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'Al-Asifat' refer to in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah An-Nazi'at is often interpreted as a reference to the 'Asif' wind that destroyed Pharaoh's army, illustrating divine retribution against arrogance. It serves as a powerful sign (ayah) of God's absolute dominion over natural forces, linking the physical scattering of clouds to the spiritual scattering of the disbelievers' hopes.
